data.name: Touhou: Your Reimu
data.detailed_description:
Bring Reimu to your desktop

Your Reimu is a desktop companion who shares your daily life with Hakurei Reimu from Touhou Project.

Leave Reimu in a corner of your screen while you work. Now and then she'll mutter to herself, greet you when you come back after a while, and tell you something different on special days.

Indifferent and blunt, but she stays by your side in her own way.

Click, lift, and move her around

Click Reimu and she'll react with a line of dialogue. Keep clicking over and over and she might grumble that you're being a pain.

Press and hold to lift Reimu up and move her wherever you like. She sways and tilts as she follows your cursor, then settles naturally wherever you let go.

You can also resize her with the mouse wheel, and her position and size are kept even after you restart the app.

Leave your to-dos with Reimu

Put a simple TODO list on your desktop to jot down what you need to get done.

Add tasks, check off the ones you've finished, or delete the ones you don't need. Reimu reacts each time you knock one out, and when you clear the whole list she'll acknowledge your effort, saying you've earned a little rest today.

“Got one done. Not bad, actually.”

Timers and alarms too

When you need to focus, start a timer right away or enter any duration you like. You can also set an alarm to go off at a specific time.

One minute before the timer ends, Reimu lets you know it's time to wrap up, and when time's up she nudges you herself along with an alert sound.

“I'll watch the clock. You just do your thing.”

The TODO list and alarm widgets can each be opened separately and moved wherever you like.

Never in the way, but always there

Areas without Reimu or a widget stay clickable, so she won't get in the way of other programs. Talk to her only when you feel like it, or open the TODO list and alarm when you need them.

Less of a secretary who does the work for you, more of a housemate who watches from the side and chimes in now and then.

Spend your days with Reimu—blunt, allergic to hassle, and fond of a good donation.

data.short_description: Hakurei Reimu comes to your desktop. Poke her or pick her up and she reacts just like Reimu would, and she'll keep an eye on your to-dos and alarms too. Blunt, but the type who quietly sticks by your side.
data.supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Korean*, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 730
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
